rationale: Both code findings from the edge-case lens review were verified and resolved: StatusLabel.tsx coerces unique_users_count to a number so string '1' correctly resolves to singular 'use'/'total use' (CR-001), and helpers.ts formatExactCount guards with Number(value) || 0 to avoid rendering literal 'NaN' on non-numeric strings (CR-002). Unit tests for both edge cases were added and pass.

finding_status.notes: StatusLabel.tsx coerces count at line 55 via Number(assistant.unique_users_count ?? 0). Numeric string '1' evaluates to number 1 and triggers singular 'use' / 'total use' branch. Covered by unit test in StatusLabel.test.tsx.

helpers.ts formatExactCount guards input via (Number(value) || 0).toLocaleString('en-US'), falling back to 0 for non-numeric truthy strings instead of rendering 'NaN'. Covered by unit test in helpers.test.ts.
